title: Game2Player: Scaling Gameplay Experience for Visual Agents through Environment-Player Co-Development
title_zh: Game2Player：通过环境与玩家协同开发，规模化采集视觉智能体的游戏经验
abstract_en: Games are a rich testbed for visual agents, demanding perception, long-horizon planning, and precise control. However, collecting human gameplay is costly, and learning from gameplay videos requires inferring missing actions. Existing datasets also cover a limited range of games, often without explicit tasks or verifiable outcomes. To address these gaps, we introduce Game2Player, a framework that co-develops game environments and players to collect diverse and verifiable gameplay experience at scale. In the Game2Player loop, a Builder agent adapts existing web games, exposes their internal state, and defines tasks with state-based progress measures and success checks. A Coding Player and a VLM Player then attempt the tasks and report problems to the Builder for repair, so that play serves as both environment validation and training data collection. With Game2Player, we build 568 verified web games with 3,436 tasks, collect 15.7K trajectories (307 hours of gameplay), and hold out 50 games as the benchmark PlayerBench. To evaluate the collected experience as training data, we train VLM agents with progress-weighted SFT, assigning greater weight to steps that advance task progress. Game2Player-9B improves progress from 14.3% to 31.2% on PlayerBench and from 30.0% to 53.1% on the external GameWorld benchmark. More broadly, our work suggests a path for visual agents to scale their gameplay experience by building, verifying, and learning from existing game worlds.
abstract_zh: 游戏能同时考验视觉智能体的感知、长程规划和精确控制能力，但采集人类游戏数据成本较高，从游戏视频学习又需要推断未记录的动作。现有数据集覆盖的游戏种类有限，也往往缺少明确的任务和可验证的结果。为此，论文提出 Game2Player，通过协同开发游戏环境与玩家来规模化采集多样、可验证的游戏经验。Builder 智能体改造现有网页游戏，开放游戏内部状态，并据此定义任务进度指标与成功判据。Coding Player 和 VLM Player 尝试完成任务，并将发现的问题反馈给 Builder 修复，使试玩同时承担环境验证和训练数据采集的功能。该框架共构建了 568 个经过验证的网页游戏和 3,436 项任务，采集了约 1.57 万条轨迹，累计 307 小时，并留出 50 个游戏组成 PlayerBench。使用进度加权监督微调（progress-weighted SFT）训练后，Game2Player-9B 的任务进度指标在 PlayerBench 上从 14.3% 提升到 31.2%，在外部基准 GameWorld 上从 30.0% 提升到 53.1%。
key_points_zh: Builder 开放网页游戏的内部状态，将任务进度和成功条件定义为可自动检验的指标。
Coding Player 和 VLM Player 试玩任务并反馈问题；Builder 据此修复环境，试玩轨迹同时用作训练数据。
共验证 568 个网页游戏、定义 3,436 项任务，采集约 1.57 万条轨迹（307 小时），并留出 50 个游戏构成 PlayerBench。
进度加权 SFT 对推进任务的步骤赋予更高权重；Game2Player-9B 在 PlayerBench 和 GameWorld 上的任务进度分别提升了 16.9 和 23.1 个百分点。

agent-harness-evolution.reason: 玩家根据实玩结果修订策略代码，构建器核验报告后修复环境；无报告对照量化了反馈价值，轨迹还用于更新模型参数，但改进机制本身未演化。
